description: Password reset completion: single-use expiring token, new-password validation and session revocation.

cases.log: Audit row UserPasswordReset (actor = the account itself, no details); log "Password of account {UserId} reset through its link."
preconditions: Live reset link with token "T-abc" for active account lan@x.vn that has a password; every session of the account is open.
cases.return: UserResult Success (MSG92); the password hash is replaced, the link is spent, every refresh token of the account is revoked before and again after the save.

preconditions: The token store has no live record of the token (unknown, expired after 60 minutes, spent or replaced by a newer link).
Token is dead and the new password is also too short.
cases.return: UserResult Failure(PasswordResetLinkInvalid) (MSG93): the link is checked before the password.
UserResult InvalidInformation (MSG94) with errors[newPassword] = "Mật khẩu phải có ít nhất 12 ký tự."; the link is not spent and can be reused for a corrected password.
UserResult InvalidInformation (MSG94) with errors[newPassword]; link still usable.

preconditions: Live reset link T-abc for an active account with a password.
cases.return: UserResult Success (MSG92): 12 characters is the minimum.

preconditions: The link is live when read, but a simultaneous submission spends it first.
cases.return: UserResult Failure(PasswordResetLinkInvalid) (MSG93): the consume does not return the account id; no password changed.

cases.log: Log "Password reset refused: account {UserId} is gone, deactivated or has no password."
preconditions: Link T-abc belongs to an account deactivated after the link was sent.
cases.return: UserResult Failure(PasswordResetLinkInvalid) (MSG93); the link is spent and the password is unchanged.

cases.log: Log "Password reset refused: account {UserId} is gone, deactivated or has no password."
preconditions: Link T-abc belongs to an account that no longer exists.
Link T-abc belongs to a Google-only account (no password hash).
cases.return: UserResult Failure(PasswordResetLinkInvalid) (MSG93): a reset does not add password sign-in.

cases.log: Error log "Password of account {UserId} was reset, but the second session revoke failed..."; audit row UserPasswordReset.
preconditions: Live link; the second session revoke (after the save) fails.
cases.return: UserResult Success (MSG92): the new password is saved; the failure is logged, not raised.

preconditions: The same link was used successfully a moment ago.
cases.return: UserResult Failure(PasswordResetLinkInvalid) (MSG93): a link cannot be reused after a successful reset.

precondition: Active and deactivated users seeded; reset email sender replaced by a recorder.
